goal: Use a taught spelling pattern to attempt a word, check its pronunciation and connect it with meaning.
cue: Blend boat with oa as one vowel unit. Read snow with ow as /oʊ/. Later compare the different ow sound in cow.
spelling: oa commonly represents /oʊ/. ow can represent /oʊ/ or /aʊ/, so confirm unfamiliar words.

articulation.label: boat
articulation.alt: boat: /b/ → /oʊ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: coat
articulation.alt: coat: /k/ → /oʊ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: snow
articulation.alt: snow: /s/ → /n/ → /oʊ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: grow
articulation.alt: grow: /ɡ/ → /r/ → /oʊ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
